title: Website Audit & SEO Strategy
highlight: Turns guesswork into a clear roadmap
shortDesc: We start with a complete website audit to identify opportunities, fix issues, and create a strategy tailored to your goals.
overview:
Every effective SEO campaign starts with knowing exactly where you stand. We run a full audit of your site's technical health, content, backlink profile, and competitive landscape, then translate those findings into a prioritized, custom strategy built around your business goals rather than a one-size-fits-all checklist.

Most businesses come to us after trying scattered SEO tactics with no real plan — a plugin here, a blog post there — with little to show for it. Our audit process replaces that guesswork with a clear diagnosis: what's broken, what's working, what's missing, and what actually moves the needle for your specific industry and audience. You walk away knowing exactly where your budget and effort should go next.
benefits: A clear, prioritized roadmap instead of guesswork
Early identification of issues holding back your rankings
A strategy tied directly to your business goals
A benchmark to measure future progress against
A full technical, content, and backlink health check in one place
Recommendations ranked by effort vs. impact, not just a raw issue list
A realistic timeline for what to expect and when
A foundation every other SEO service builds on

process.desc: We learn your business, goals, and target audience.
We review technical health, on-page content, and backlinks.
We see where you stand against the businesses you're competing with.
You get a prioritized action plan built for your goals.
We present the findings live and answer any questions before you commit to next steps.

faqs.q: How long does a full website audit take?
faqs.a: Most audits take 5–10 business days depending on site size and complexity. Larger sites with more pages, subdomains, or backlink history take a bit longer to review thoroughly.

faqs.q: Will I get a written report I can keep?
faqs.a: Yes. You'll receive a detailed, prioritized action plan covering technical issues, content gaps, and competitor insights — organized by impact so you know what to tackle first.

faqs.q: Do you audit competitors too, or just my site?
faqs.a: Both. Understanding where you stand relative to competitors is part of the process, since it shapes which opportunities are realistic and worth prioritizing.

faqs.q: What happens after the audit is delivered?
faqs.a: We walk you through the findings and, if you'd like to move forward, help you implement the strategy through our other SEO services like on-page optimization or technical SEO.

faqs.q: Do I need to already have Google Analytics or Search Console set up?
faqs.a: It helps but isn't required. If you don't have them set up, we'll get them configured correctly as part of the audit so we're working from accurate data.

faqs.q: Is this a one-time audit or an ongoing service?
faqs.a: The initial audit is a one-time deep dive, but we recommend revisiting the strategy every 6–12 months as your site, competitors, and search algorithms evolve.

title: On-Page Optimization
highlight: Every page working as hard as it can
shortDesc: From keyword research to meta tags, headings, and content improvements, we optimize every page for search engines and users.
overview:
On-page optimization makes sure every page on your site is working as hard as it can. We research the keywords your customers are actually searching for, then refine titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and content so each page is built to rank and to convert.

It's easy to have a website that looks great but never shows up in search results because the underlying structure doesn't speak the language search engines — or your customers — actually use. We fix that page by page, aligning what you offer with the exact terms people type into Google, without sacrificing readability or turning your content into a keyword-stuffed mess.
benefits: Pages built around real customer search terms
Improved click-through rates from better titles and descriptions
Stronger internal linking and site structure
Content that serves both search engines and real readers
Cleaner heading structure that's easier for both users and crawlers to scan
Image alt text and file names optimized for image search visibility
Reduced keyword cannibalization between similar pages
A/B-informed title tags that improve organic click-through rate over time

process.desc: We find the terms your customers are searching for.
We review titles, headings, meta tags, and content.
We rewrite and restructure pages for clarity and relevance.
We track rankings and refine as results come in.
We periodically revisit top pages to keep them aligned with search trends.

faqs.q: Will changing my page titles and content hurt my current rankings?
faqs.a: No. We make changes strategically and monitor rankings closely afterward. Any short-term fluctuation is normal and typically resolves into improved rankings within a few weeks.

faqs.q: How do you decide which keywords to target?
faqs.a: We research actual search volume, competition, and intent behind terms your customers use, then match those keywords to the pages best suited to rank for them.

faqs.q: Do you rewrite my existing content or just tweak it?
faqs.a: It depends on the page. Some content just needs better structure and keyword placement, while thin or outdated pages may need a more substantial rewrite.

faqs.q: How soon will I see ranking improvements?
faqs.a: Most clients start seeing movement within 4–8 weeks, though this varies by competition level and how established your site already is.

faqs.q: Will this affect how my site looks to visitors?
faqs.a: Visually, very little changes. Most of the work happens in text, structure, and metadata — your design and layout stay the same unless a structural fix is needed.

faqs.q: Do you optimize product pages and blog posts the same way?
faqs.a: No, each page type has different intent. Product pages are optimized for conversion-focused keywords, while blog content is optimized for informational, longer-tail searches.

title: Technical SEO
highlight: Fast, crawlable, and error-free by design
shortDesc: Fast-loading, mobile-friendly, and error-free websites perform better in rankings. We handle site speed, indexing, structured data, and technical fixes.
overview:
Search engines reward sites that are fast, crawlable, and free of errors. We dig into your site's technical foundation, fixing indexing issues, improving load times, cleaning up structured data, and making sure your site works flawlessly on every device.

Many businesses invest heavily in content and design while the technical plumbing underneath quietly holds everything back — broken redirects, slow servers, unindexed pages, or duplicate content confusing search engines about which version to rank. We find and fix these issues so the great content you already have actually gets the visibility it deserves.
benefits: Faster load times that keep visitors on your site
Improved crawlability and indexing by search engines
Structured data that helps you stand out in search results
A mobile experience that meets modern ranking standards
Cleaned-up redirect chains and broken link fixes
Resolved duplicate content and canonicalization issues
Core Web Vitals improvements that support both rankings and user experience
A secure, properly configured HTTPS setup with no mixed-content warnings

process.desc: We scan your entire site for errors and blockers.
We test performance across devices.
We add schema markup where it helps you stand out.
We resolve issues and keep watching for new ones.
We optimize loading, interactivity, and visual stability scores.

faqs.q: What counts as a 'technical SEO' issue?
faqs.a: Things like slow load times, broken links, duplicate content, crawl errors, missing structured data, and mobile usability problems — anything that stops search engines from properly reading or ranking your site.

faqs.q: Do you need access to my hosting or CMS?
faqs.a: For most fixes, yes — we'll need access to your CMS (like WordPress) or a developer contact if changes need to go through your dev team or hosting provider.

faqs.q: Will fixing technical issues affect my site's design?
faqs.a: No. Technical SEO work happens behind the scenes — in code, server settings, and markup — and doesn't change how your site looks to visitors.

faqs.q: How do you monitor for new technical issues?
faqs.a: We set up ongoing crawls and alerts so new errors, broken links, or indexing problems are caught early instead of quietly hurting your rankings.

faqs.q: What are Core Web Vitals and why do they matter?
faqs.a: They're Google's metrics for loading speed, interactivity, and visual stability. They're a confirmed ranking factor and also directly affect whether visitors stay or bounce.

faqs.q: Can slow site speed really affect my rankings that much?
faqs.a: Yes. Speed affects both rankings directly and user behavior — slow sites see higher bounce rates, which further signals to search engines that the page isn't serving users well.

title: Local SEO
highlight: Get found by customers near you
shortDesc: Get found by customers near you! We optimize your Google Business Profile, local citations, and location-based keywords so you dominate local searches.
overview:
Most customers start their search close to home. We optimize your Google Business Profile, build consistent local citations, and target location-based keywords so your business shows up when nearby customers are ready to buy.

Local search behaves differently than general SEO — proximity, review signals, and listing consistency all play an outsized role. Whether you run a single storefront or manage several locations, we make sure your business appears prominently right when someone nearby is searching for exactly what you offer, not just somewhere on page two of Google.
benefits: Higher visibility in local map pack results
A fully optimized, up-to-date Google Business Profile
Consistent business listings across the web
More foot traffic and local phone calls
Location-specific landing pages for multi-location businesses
Cleaned-up NAP (name, address, phone) consistency across directories
Local review generation and response strategy
Better visibility for 'near me' and location-based search queries

process.desc: We build out your Google Business Profile fully.
We create consistent listings across local directories.
We optimize pages around location-based searches.
We help you build and manage local reviews.
We monitor map pack and local rankings across your service areas.

faqs.q: What is the 'map pack' and why does it matter?
faqs.a: The map pack is the group of local business listings Google shows at the top of search results with a map. It gets a huge share of clicks for local searches, so ranking there matters a lot for foot traffic and calls.

faqs.q: Do I need multiple locations for this to work?
faqs.a: No, local SEO benefits single-location businesses just as much — it's about matching your business to nearby searchers, whether you have one location or fifty.

faqs.q: Can you help with online reviews?
faqs.a: Yes, we help you build a steady stream of genuine reviews and respond to them appropriately, since review volume and recency both influence local rankings.

faqs.q: How is local SEO different from regular SEO?
faqs.a: Local SEO focuses specifically on location signals — your Google Business Profile, citations, local keywords, and reviews — rather than general site-wide rankings.

faqs.q: What if my business has multiple locations?
faqs.a: We build out separate, properly optimized profiles and location pages for each address so every location can rank independently in its own local market.

faqs.q: How quickly can I expect to see local ranking improvements?
faqs.a: Google Business Profile optimizations often show movement within a few weeks, while citation building and review growth typically take a couple months to fully compound.

title: Content Creation & Optimization
highlight: Content that earns trust and rankings
shortDesc: We create and optimize high-quality content that targets the right keywords, answers your customers' questions, and establishes your brand as an industry authority.
overview:
Content is how you earn trust and rankings at the same time. We create and refine content that answers the real questions your customers are asking, targets the keywords that matter, and positions your brand as the authority in your space.

Great content does two jobs at once: it satisfies search engines' need for depth and relevance, and it genuinely helps the person reading it make a decision. We build content around what your audience is actually searching for at every stage of their journey, from early research questions to final purchase comparisons, so your site becomes the resource people return to and trust.
benefits: Content built around real customer questions
Stronger topical authority in your industry
More organic traffic from long-tail keywords
Content that supports every stage of the buyer journey
A content calendar aligned to seasonal and search demand trends
Refreshed, re-optimized versions of your best-performing older content
Internal linking that connects related content into topic clusters
Content formatted for featured snippets and voice search results

process.desc: We find what your audience is actually asking.
We write content that's helpful, clear, and on-brand.
We optimize structure, keywords, and formatting.
We track what's working and refine the rest.
We update and republish older content to keep it competitive.

faqs.q: Who actually writes the content?
faqs.a: Our content team writes every piece, working from research into your industry and audience so the tone and substance match your brand rather than reading like generic filler.

faqs.q: How often should I publish new content?
faqs.a: This depends on your industry and goals, but consistency matters more than volume — a steady, sustainable publishing schedule outperforms sporadic bursts.

faqs.q: Do you optimize old content or only write new pieces?
faqs.a: Both. Refreshing and re-optimizing existing pages is often faster to show results than starting from scratch, so we typically do a mix of the two.

faqs.q: How do you measure whether content is working?
faqs.a: We track organic traffic, keyword rankings, and engagement for each piece, then use that data to guide what topics and formats to prioritize next.

faqs.q: Do you handle content for product pages too, or just blog posts?
faqs.a: We work across both — blog and resource content for research-stage traffic, and refined product or service page copy for conversion-stage traffic.

faqs.q: Will the content sound like it was written by AI?
faqs.a: No, every piece is written and reviewed by our content team to match your brand voice, and edited to read naturally rather than like generic, templated copy.

title: Link Building & Authority Growth
highlight: Authority built the right way, no shortcuts
shortDesc: We build high quality backlinks that increase your website's credibility and push you higher on search engines.
overview:
Backlinks remain one of the strongest ranking signals search engines use. We earn high-quality, relevant links from credible sources, building your site's authority the right way — no shortcuts or spammy tactics that put your rankings at risk.

A lot of businesses have been burned by cheap link-building schemes that either do nothing or actively hurt their rankings. We take the opposite approach: manual outreach, relevant partnerships, and content worth linking to. It's slower than buying links in bulk, but it's the kind of authority growth that actually holds up over time and doesn't put your site at risk of penalties.
benefits: Increased domain authority and trust
Higher rankings for competitive keywords
Referral traffic from reputable sites
A safe, sustainable link profile
Manual, relevant outreach — no automated or bulk-bought links
Ongoing toxic link monitoring and disavow support
Digital PR opportunities that build brand visibility alongside links
Competitor backlink gap analysis to find realistic opportunities

process.desc: We review your current backlink profile.
We identify relevant, high-authority link opportunities.
We earn quality links through outreach and content.
We track authority growth and remove toxic links.
We reassess targets and adjust outreach based on results.

faqs.q: Is link building safe? I've heard it can get sites penalized.
faqs.a: Only spammy, manipulative tactics risk penalties. We only pursue relevant, high-authority links earned through genuine outreach and content, which is the approach search engines actually reward.

faqs.q: How many backlinks will I get?
faqs.a: Quality matters far more than quantity — a handful of relevant, authoritative links outperforms dozens of low-quality ones, so we focus on the former.

faqs.q: What if I already have bad or toxic backlinks?
faqs.a: We audit your existing backlink profile first and can identify and disavow toxic links that might be holding your rankings back.

faqs.q: How long before link building affects my rankings?
faqs.a: Link building is a longer-term play — expect to see meaningful authority and ranking gains over 3–6 months as links get discovered and indexed.

faqs.q: Do you buy links or use link farms?
faqs.a: No. We only pursue links earned through genuine relevance and outreach, since bought links and link farms violate search engine guidelines and risk penalties.

faqs.q: Can link building help a brand-new website?
faqs.a: Yes, though new sites typically need a foundation of solid content and technical health first, since links work best when there's something worth linking to.

title: Tracking & Reporting
shortDesc: You'll receive transparent reports that show keyword rankings, traffic growth, and ROI. No fluff, just results.
overview:
You should always know exactly what your SEO investment is producing. We track keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and ROI, and deliver clear, transparent reports so you can see precisely what's working and why.

Too many SEO reports are full of vanity metrics that look impressive but don't tell you anything about actual business impact. We build reporting around outcomes that matter — leads, calls, sales, and revenue-driving traffic — so every conversation about your SEO program is grounded in real numbers, not just ranking screenshots.
benefits: Full transparency into rankings and traffic
Reports tied to real business outcomes, not vanity metrics
Regular check-ins to review progress
Data-driven adjustments to your strategy over time
Custom dashboards you can access anytime, not just at report time
Clear attribution between SEO activity and conversions or leads
Competitor benchmark tracking alongside your own metrics
Plain-English explanations, not just raw data dumps

process.desc: We set up analytics and rank tracking correctly.
We deliver clear reports on rankings and traffic.
We walk through what's working and what's next.
We adjust the plan based on real data.
We step back for a broader look at trends and long-term progress.

faqs.q: How often will I receive reports?
faqs.a: Reports are delivered monthly, with a walkthrough of what's working, what's changed, and what we're adjusting for the next period.

faqs.q: What metrics actually matter in an SEO report?
faqs.a: We focus on outcomes tied to your business — organic traffic, keyword rankings, and conversions — rather than vanity metrics that look good but don't reflect real growth.

faqs.q: Can I access the data myself between reports?
faqs.a: Yes, we set up dashboards and tracking so you can check in on rankings and traffic anytime, not just when a formal report arrives.

faqs.q: What if the reports show something isn't working?
faqs.a: That's exactly what reporting is for — we use the data to refine the strategy, whether that means shifting keyword focus, content topics, or technical priorities.

faqs.q: Will you show me how SEO connects to actual sales or leads?
faqs.a: Yes, where tracking allows it, we connect organic traffic and keyword performance to actual conversions so you can see genuine return on investment.

faqs.q: Do I need to understand analytics tools myself to use these reports?
faqs.a: No, reports are written in plain language with the key takeaways explained clearly — you don't need to be an analytics expert to understand your results.

title: Competitor Analysis
highlight: Know their moves before they make them
shortDesc: We keep an eye on what your competitors are doing online tracking their keywords, backlinks, and strategies so we can position your business a step ahead.
overview:
Knowing what your competitors are doing is often the fastest way to find your own opportunities. We track their keywords, content, and backlinks, uncovering gaps and openings you can use to move ahead of them in search results.

Rather than guessing what might work, we study what's already proven to work for the businesses ranking above you. That means identifying the specific keywords they own, the content formats driving their traffic, and the sources linking to them — then building a plan to outrank them where it matters most, not just imitate what they're doing.
benefits: A clear picture of the competitive landscape
Keyword and content gaps you can capitalize on
Insight into competitor backlink strategies
A strategy built to outrank, not just keep pace
Ongoing tracking of competitor ranking movements
Benchmarking of your site's visibility against direct competitors
Identification of underserved topics competitors haven't covered well
A prioritized list of quick-win opportunities based on competitor weaknesses

process.desc: We identify who you're really competing with online.
We find what they rank for that you don't.
We study where their authority comes from.
We turn findings into a clear action plan.
We track shifts in competitor rankings and strategy over time.

faqs.q: How do you identify who my real competitors are?
faqs.a: We look beyond the businesses you consider rivals and identify who's actually ranking for the keywords that matter to you, since those are your true search competitors.

faqs.q: What's a 'content gap' exactly?
faqs.a: It's a topic or keyword your competitors rank for that your site doesn't currently cover — often a quick opportunity to capture traffic you're currently missing.

faqs.q: Will you tell me exactly how competitors are getting their backlinks?
faqs.a: Yes, we review where their authority comes from so you can pursue similar or better link opportunities in your own outreach.

faqs.q: How often should competitor analysis be redone?
faqs.a: We recommend revisiting it quarterly at minimum, since competitors' strategies and rankings shift over time and new players can enter the space.

faqs.q: Can this help me if I'm entering a new market?
faqs.a: Yes, it's especially useful then — understanding who already ranks and why helps you avoid wasted effort and focus on realistic opportunities from day one.

faqs.q: Do you monitor competitors on an ongoing basis, or is this a one-time report?
faqs.a: Both are available. A one-time analysis gives you a strong starting point, while ongoing monitoring keeps you aware of new competitor moves as they happen.
